title: 無表示の超音波装置カート
titleEn: Ultrasound equipment cart with blank screen
description: 診療施設の室内背景に置く移動式超音波装置外装。四輪台車・背面サービス部、文字のないキー/固定つまみ/トラックボール、角度を付けた無表示モニター、二本の保持プローブと曲線ケーブル、後部押し手を造形。画面は不透明PBRで画像・患者情報を含みません。画像取得、診断、音波・電気動作や医療機器安全性能は実装・検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.687 × 1.642 × 0.716 m、16,884三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A mobile ultrasound-system exterior for clinical interior backgrounds. It has a four-caster base/rear service area, unlettered keys/fixed controls/trackball, angled blank monitor, two parked probe exteriors with curved cables and rear push handle. The screen is opaque PBR and contains no imaging or patient data. Image capture, diagnosis, acoustic/electrical behavior and medical-device safety are not implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.687 × 1.642 × 0.716 m; 16,884 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
